headline: New Update!  -  1.1.8
openingRemarks: New Foe! - Plaguebringer, Rankings by activities, changes to running and other activities!

newFeatures.title: A New Foe arrived from the NetherRealm: The Plaguebringer
newFeatures.description: Available after level 20, earn a Plagueling pet for defeating The Plaguebringer. If you survive, he'll infect your hero, causing health loss equal to half the heroe's regeneration rate for 24 hours.

newFeatures.title: Ranking By Activities
newFeatures.description: There is now a dropdown box to select different activities and view how you rank among the HeroFit community. Who's going to be the top runner? the top yogi?

newFeatures.title: XP,Elemental, Power changes to Fire activities, swimming, and elliptical
newFeatures.description: Fire activities, swimming, and elliptical will now grant XP, Elemental points, and Power 50% faster. This is because of the strenuousness of the activities per minutes spent. This may change in the future. IMPORTANT - this change will be retroactive, meaning on your next level up, your total xp, power, and elements will be calculated fresh with the new changes. You'll likely have a big upgrade to make up the difference.

bugFixes: Fixed a bug where new players couldn't get past new patch window
Fixed a bug where the battle time was off by one hour because of daylight savings time
Fixed issue where the last page of the rankings was not showing
Fixed an issue where my contact form messages and error-reporting emails were not being sent
Fixed an issue where sometimes the reward for an upcoming battle win would not show in the Awaiting Battle window
balanceChanges: On going foe difficulty tweaks, working on finding the right balance
miscDetails: Ongoing improvements to the backend API are underway. Nothing fancy for the user, but for the developers out there, We're improving request body validation and formatting responses.
Likewise on the frontend, we're working on refactoring how the http requests are handled and presenting error messages.
closingRemarks: It's clear from the previous patch feedback that there hasn't been enough documentation about how to use new features. Also, more items are needed, especially at the lower levels. This will be addressed in upcoming patches. Thanks again for playing!
